name: Adaptive Bit-Packed Voxel Array
definition: A storage structure for a 16x16x16 voxel section (4096 voxels) that dynamically adjusts its memory layout based on the number of unique voxel IDs present, supporting empty, uniform, palette, and bit-packed states.
summary: The Adaptive Bit-Packed Voxel Array is a memory-efficient structure for 16x16x16 voxel sections that dynamically adjusts its layout based on unique IDs, using index-based palette lookups to optimize sparse and homogeneous data.
